items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?
02. Briefly describe your educational background, specialized training, and professional experiences that have prepared you for the position of Campus Security Officer at Orange Coast College.
03. Have you had prior experience on a college/university campus dealing with students? If so, what was that experience?

04. Situational Question: While on shift, you receive a call regarding a disruptive student. When you arrive on the scene, the student is angry and refuses to leave the classroom. The Instructor is upset and wants the student out of her classroom immediately. There are other students in the classroom, and they are visibly shaken. How would you respond to this situation?

05. Please list the following situations by order of response priority (#1 being the highest priority - #10 the lowest): Request for an escort by a female student during evening hours, stolen vehicle report, broken water pipe, subjects fighting in the parking lot, suspicious package in the OCC Student Union Building, missing child at the OCC swap meet, a missing student at the OCC Harbor Residential Housing, lost campus keys, medical aid - student complaining of dizziness, unlock classroom for a faculty member, vehicle jump-start.

06. This is an in-house-only recruitment: This position is open to internal permanent and temporary employees of the Coast Community College District (CCCD). External candidates are NOT eligible to apply. If you are not a current CCCD employee, please do not apply at this time. Are you currently employed by the Coast Community College District as an active employee? Options: Yes | No

08. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses required, as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

09. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No
Requires a valid California Driver's License.
Requires current First Aid, CPR, and AED certifications within a reasonable time after employment.

The position requires a High School diploma or equivalent, 21 years of age, and two years of security/surveillance experience, supplemented by specialized, successful training in security, safety, and behavior intervention. Additional higher education in public safety, jurisprudence, or a related field may substitute for experience. Experience in campus safety and/or law enforcement is preferred .
Additional higher education in public safety, jurisprudence, or a related field may substitute for experience.
Experience in campus safety and/or law enforcement is preferred .
Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.
Completion of 24-hour SB1626 or 40-hour 832 PC class.
Work is performed indoors and outdoors where safety and health considerations exist from temperature extremes, physical effort, and at-risk incidents.

Evidence of demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students. (California Code of Regulations Title 553022; Education Code Section 87360; Coast Community College District EEO Plan)
